verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that typing `[[]]` creates or references pages, and `(())` references blocks, so wiki-style linking is documented. Nothing in the pack shows a backlinks panel, unlinked mentions, or viewing references in context, which is the larger part of the story. Missing for 10: documented backlinks/linked-references view, unlinked mentions detection, in-context display of references, independent or hands-on corroboration.
